description: This PHP class 'Supervisor' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and defines display fields related to supervisors within the HRM reporting system of OrangeHRM. It specifies the DTO class, fields, and entity aliases pertinent to supervisor data display.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: Represents a supervisor display field in the HRM reporting system, providing methods to retrieve DTO class, relevant fields, and entity aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with supervisor data.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields related to the employee's supervisor, specifically 'employee.empNumber'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used within the report, in this case 'supervisor'.
